0022600160.text: The Pacers (2-5, on a four-game losing streak, 3rd in the Central and 12th in the East) host the Atlanta Hawks (3-4, on a one-game losing streak, 2nd in the Southeast and 7th in the East) in Indiana's eighth game of the season, with the Pacers at 0-3 at home and the Hawks at 1-2 on the road. Indiana is missing Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Obi Toppin (back soreness) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), with Jalen Johnson (ankle) listed as day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Pacers lost their series 1-2, with Indiana's most recent meeting a 129-124 win in Indianapolis on January 31, 2026.
